# laravel_cloud_websocket_server (Resource)

Manages a Laravel Cloud WebSocket server (cluster).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravel_cloud_websocket_server" "example" {
  name   = "my-reverb"
  type   = "reverb"
  region = "us-east-2"

  # Valid values: 100, 200, 500, 2000, 5000, 10000.
  max_connections = 5000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_connections` (Number) Maximum concurrent connections.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `region` (String) Cloud region.
- `type` (String) Server type (e.g. reverb).

### Read-Only

- `connection_distribution_strategy` (String) Strategy used to distribute connections across the server.
- `created_at` (String)
- `hostname` (String) Server hostname.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Server status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravel_cloud_websocket_server.example "{server_id}"
```
